why: 1F units have several glazed fronts (e.g. #3 fronts 0,1,6,10; #4 1,5,6,8; #16 1,2): the kit builds wall panels + colliders on every edge except `front`, i.e. over the other shop glass. Auto fixtures ignore storefront doors and irregular polygons (props land outside the unit or in the door aisle) and restaurant dining sets are uncapped (triangle budget <=120k per spec for 16 units). The generator needs to place fixtures explicitly to follow footage (e.g. 양산국밥 dining tables, 복순도가 fridges + sales counter).

params.openEdges: [int] edges besides `front` that get NO wall panel, skirting, joint or collider (extra glazed fronts carried by kit Storefronts / open sides). Default [].
params.back: int edge that takes the `backWall` finish (default unchanged: farthest edge from the front, but never one in openEdges).
params.layout: [{fixture, at [u,v] (element frame, footprint centre on the floor), heading [du,dv] (display/customer side = the prop's front), length?, depth?, height?, elevation?}] — when present it REPLACES the kind's automatic fixtures (walls/ceiling/downlights/light unchanged). Fixture keys map to the existing KitShop helpers: tableSet (KTableSet: round table + 2 chairs across heading's left/right), dining (kit_dining 1.5x.9x1.55), kitchen (kit_kitchenTable, length default 1.35 → scaled width), counter (kit_kitchenCounter, length default 1.2 → scaled width, depth .65), menu (KMenuBoards: wall-mounted, `at` = point on the wall face, heading = out of the wall, length = board run, elevation = centre height default 2.15), shelf (KShelf one-sided, `at` = back line centre, length, height 2.0, depth .4, KitProducts, 5 levels), gondola (KShelf two-sided, faces ±heading, run along the perpendicular, length, height 1.5, depth .4, 4 levels), cooler (KCooler, `at` = cabinet centre, length), bakeryShelf (KShelf one-sided Kit_Bread, height 1.6, depth .45, 4 levels), loafTable (kit_tableMedium 1.2x.8x.8 + KLoaves), cabinet (kit_cabinet 1x.9x.5, length scales width), plant (kit_plant .5x.75x.5). Unknown fixture key = element error. `length` is always the extent perpendicular to heading.

contract: The generator guarantees containment in the polygon and door clearance; the kit does not need to test them. Without these params the output must be unchanged (KORAIL lounge 2FM-KORAIL-LOUNGE, kit showcase).
